guard: cooperative dispatcher retirement can settle a release as terminal-success only with a completed collector and an empty unproven set
why: Dispatcher retirement is an observed local fact, not native-effect proof and not a journal receipt.
Non-empty unproven live requests remain indeterminate. An empty set without a completed collector is not a drain.

mutations.name: allow dispatcher-retirement on prepared
mutations.find:
if (proofOrigin?.kind === "dispatcher-retirement" && proofOrigin.proves === "dispatcher-retirement-only" && value.state !== "indeterminate")
    return fail(`session operation ${key}`, "dispatcher-retirement proof cannot settle an operation as anything except indeterminate");
mutations.expectRed: dispatcher-retirement cannot sit on a prepared operation
mutations.cell: dispatcher-retirement cannot sit on a prepared operation

mutations.name: accept dispatcher-retirement without admissionClosed
mutations.find:
if (value.admissionClosed !== true || value.dispatcherSettled !== true || value.retiredStatePersisted !== true)
      return fail(label, "does not prove admission closed, dispatcher settled, and retired state persisted");
mutations.expectRed: dispatcher-retirement without admissionClosed is not proof
mutations.cell: dispatcher-retirement without admissionClosed is not proof

mutations.name: skip id() on unproven live request ids
mutations.expectRed: unproven live request ids must be id tokens
mutations.cell: unproven live request ids must be id tokens

mutations.name: refuse cooperative-retirement as terminal-success proof
mutations.expectRed: cooperative §121 drain can settle terminal-success without native-effect
mutations.cell: cooperative §121 drain can settle terminal-success without native-effect

mutations.name: treat empty unproven ids as a completed collector
mutations.find:
if (value.liveRequestCollector !== "complete")
        return fail(label, "does not prove the live-request collector ran");
mutations.expectRed: empty unproven ids without a completed collector is not a proven drain
mutations.cell: empty unproven ids without a completed collector is not a proven drain

mutations.name: accept omitted liveRequestCollector as a proven collector
mutations.find:
if (value.liveRequestCollector !== "complete" && value.liveRequestCollector !== "unproven")
      return fail(label, "does not prove the live-request collector ran");
mutations.expectRed: omitted liveRequestCollector is not a proven drain
mutations.cell: omitted liveRequestCollector is not a proven drain

mutations.name: allow cooperative-retirement with unproven live requests
mutations.find:
if (unprovenLiveRequestIds.length !== 0)
        return fail(label, "cannot prove cooperative retirement while live requests remain unproven");
mutations.expectRed: cooperative-retirement cannot claim success while live requests remain unproven
mutations.cell: cooperative-retirement cannot claim success while live requests remain unproven

mutations.name: allow cooperative-retirement on control
mutations.find:
if (proofOrigin?.proves === "cooperative-retirement" && (value.state !== "terminal-success" || value.action !== "release"))
    return fail(`session operation ${key}`, "cooperative-retirement proof can settle only a release as terminal-success");
mutations.expectRed: control cannot settle success on cooperative-retirement
mutations.cell: control cannot settle success on cooperative-retirement
